facebook.content:
You think I came to destroy the law or the prophets, I have not come to destroy but to fulfill. Matthew 5:17

Most of us view fulfillment as achieving our own goals, but what if it's about surrendering to God's? When we align our vision with God's, we become co-creators with Him. We're not trying to force things to happen our way, but we're working with Him to bring His perfect plan to fruition.

What's one area of your life where you're struggling to surrender control and trust God's plan?

instagram.content:
You don't have to be controlled by what you don't have. The Lord is the provider, not the circumstances. 

"For the Lord your God is the one who is giving you the power to make wealth, that He may confirm His covenant which He swore to your fathers, as it is this day." - Deuteronomy 8:18 

Double tap if you're trusting God's provision in your life today.
